title: Runtime: allow implicit Agent provider when model is provider/model
description: Even after registry validation changes, the runtime agent setup still throws ValueError if Agent.provider is missing and default_provider is not set. This prevents the preferred DSL style Agent { model = "openai/gpt-4o-mini" } from running (including in mock mode), and breaks Tactus-examples.\n\nFix: In tactus/core/runtime.py agent setup, infer provider from model string when model is provider/model or provider:model. Avoid constructing malformed provider:model strings when model already includes a provider prefix. Update runtime tests accordingly.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_acceptance_criteria:
- Agent { model="openai/gpt-4o-mini" } runs without provider/default_provider
- Agent { model="bedrock/us...:0" } runs without provider/default_provider
- Agent with model="gpt-4o-mini" still errors without provider/default_provider
- Unit tests updated and passing
custom.beads_close_reason: Runtime now infers provider from provider/model or provider:model agent model strings; updated runtime tests to expect provider/model
